control.completed_scope: LasHeR 245 sequences / 220703 annotation and prediction rows only
control.timing_scope: Two concurrent inference workers sharing physical GPU 3. Synchronized per-frame timer includes image decode, crop, visual forwards, decisions and state/template update. Excludes initialization, post-timer output CPU transfer, diagnostic packing and output file writes. FPS is 220458 divided by summed worker frame durations, not total parallel wall-clock throughput.
control.completion_evidence: Both inference child exit codes 0 in historical state; two completion receipts; complete predictions/latencies; score stdout; exact report reconstruction.

main.timing_scope: Main relay source assigns both workers to physical GPU 2; main runtime observations and receipts support that role but a full original LasHeR child/controller exit trace is not in this bundle. The same synchronized timer and summed-duration FPS definition apply.

baseline_source_qualified.source: User-provided scalars only; no per-sequence user-reference bundle, no paired interval against these scalars, no pure LasHeR baseline run.
baseline_source_qualified.paired_comparison: paired_comparison.json compares actual fixed main/search_actions and control/future_actions predictions; it is separate from the user reference.

comparison_limits: Different selected epochs and head counts, one recorded training seed, reused development selection. Sequence bootstrap excludes retraining and model-selection uncertainty. No multiple-seed stability or independent causal attribution to a component.
toolkit_invalid_GT_quirk: 1260 frames with any nonpositive x/y/w/h receive error=-1: PR and NPR count them as successful, SR as failed. All frames remain in each sequence denominator. The 533 nonpositive-width/height frames form a smaller set.
